answer: One controller can spin up many sockpuppet voters. Each applicant leases one public trellis, roots a tagged vine cutting, and drives a one-shot pigment slug into the xylem only in a published tide window, then files a dated cross-section and a signed staff photo. Clerks post H=sha3_256(addr||trellis_id||pigment_lot||tide_slot||xylem_root). Lease 0.31 POA; 14 POA bond for eight epochs. Auditors recut the same internode and match the stain ring to the tide staff. A reused trellis, copied pigment lot, or off-window harvest seizes the bond and blinds both keys for twelve epochs.
